android.desc:
Key Features:

• ABHA Creation: Create and Login your ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) seamlessly through Aadhaar face authentication
• Access health records from any ABDM-enabled facility
• Upload health records to secure, government-approved health storage - DigiLocker for personal and family health management
• Quick “Scan and Share” for OPD registration at ABDM enabled hospitals, clinics, and labs.
• Digital payments for health services at registered facilities through “Scan and Pay”
• View Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PMJAY) empanelled hospitals, treatment details, and wallet balances for family members through National Health Claim Exchange (NHCX)
• Manage your Family’s health at one place by adding your family member to your account.
• Consent-based sharing of health records at ABDM-enabled facilities
• Discover doctors, laboratories, hospitals, and blood banks and blood availability anywhere in India.

Aarogya Setu 2.0 marks India’s leap toward a fully digital and connected healthcare ecosystem — giving every citizen secure, convenient, and equitable access to health and wellness services.

Previously Apple were made to bend their rules when India threatened to ban Apple devices if they don't allow TRAI Do Not Disturb app in 2018.[2]
